title: Analysis of the Ethiopic Twitter Dataset for Abusive Speech in Amharic
reasoning: The paper's central focus is the analysis of abusive, offensive, and hate speech, which is an ethical problem concerning harmful language. It discusses the societal impact of such speech and analyzes it in the context of a proposed national law against hate speech, which is an ethical and legal framework. The definition of hate speech used includes targeting groups based on religion, directly involving a faith-related dimension.
